executiveSummary.headline: Translate a Century of Landmark Authority Into Clear Event and Dining Facts
executiveSummary.lead: The Mayflower ranks second among five certified Marriott Bonvoy peers, yet appears in 19 of 46 eligible scenarios and 28.6% of comparable answers. Its first-party site documents a 581-room landmark, 100 years of history, Edgar Bar & Kitchen, and a major events platform; the priority is to make exact inventory, rounded marketing figures, and decision-ready facts consistently legible.
executiveSummary.metricsNote: AI Consideration is the share of comparable monitored answers mentioning the hotel; Scenario Presence is the share of eligible traveler-need scenarios where it appeared. Certified Peer Position uses the named governed peer set. These measures do not represent bookings, ADR, revenue, or traveler exposure.

themes.title: Label Exact and Rounded Event-Space Totals

themes.title: Strengthen Wedding and Ballroom Decision Facts
themes.what: The official page lists 27 event rooms, up to 1,000 capacity, a 7,000-square-foot Grand Ballroom, and extensive wedding positioning. ADP wedding-venue recognition was 5.2% and large-ballroom recognition was 10.9%.
themes.whyItMatters: Setup-qualified facts can improve planner context without implying a change in booking or measurement outcomes.

themes.title: Make Edgar Bar & Kitchen a Reusable Hotel Fact
themes.what: The official homepage identifies Edgar Bar & Kitchen as the hotel’s on-site American brasserie using local ingredients, while the certified attribute read recorded 54.5% on-site restaurant recognition.
themes.whyItMatters: Consistent outlet identity, location, cuisine, and service facts can reduce ambiguity across hotel and partner pages.
